verdict.rationale: The instructions half is supported: HMRC's guidance on VAT registration (with exact thresholds and a Welsh version), Corporation Tax and Making Tax Digital sign-up is published on public gov.uk pages that need no sign-in. Nothing shows downloadable forms, though, and the evidence points the other way: registration and filing run through online services that need a business tax account, plus compatible software for Making Tax Digital. Missing for 10: any evidence of downloadable forms (PDFs or paper forms) available without an account, any evidence that the instructions are offered as downloads rather than web pages, and independent corroboration.
